The work-reduction arm moved closer to ARC on this small simulated-agent trial; it did not beat ARC throughput. The vector index stayed on its small-pool flat fallback, so this run provides no index crossover or ranking-value result. All 360 requests completed with exact matching prompts, generated token lists and native ordered key chains across all eight arms.

| Observer-off product arm | Release TTFT p 50 ms | Background TTFT p 50 ms | Mean ITL ms (all) | Output tok/s | Executed prompt tokens |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc | 2742.5 | 7212.7 | 32.80 | 82.342 | 80515 |
| current | 3149.5 | 7435.3 | 33.41 | 81.257 | 82435 |
| work | 2738.5 | 7203.1 | 32.84 | 81.892 | 80563 |
| index | 3168.6 | 7435.8 | 33.45 | 81.153 | 82435 |
| combined | 2839.4 | 7219.0 | 32.86 | 81.843 | 80563 |

Each arm generated 3264 tokens over the whole client load (about 40 s); ITL uses 3219 inter-token intervals. All had 31/45 release-TTFT misses at the declared 1 s threshold, zero failures/OOMs/allocation failures. measurements.csv preserves every request, release lateness, submit TTFT, output count, overlap and denominator; no p 95 with 45 observations. One run per arm in fixed order, not repeated independent workloads or a significance result.

Work reduction vs current: throughput+0.78%, median release TTFT-13.05%; combined throughput+0.72%, median TTFT-9.85%. Work bundles stride 8 capture and opportunity-only scoring; these effects are not individually isolated. Its throughput remains-0.55% vs ARC. Index/current differ by only-0.13% throughput with identical prompt work and tiny pools; do not treat that as an index effect.

Actual opportunity was small: natural threshold 2 admitted 11 blocks (24.75 MiB) into the unchanged 448 MiB DRAM tier. There was at most one eligible paused session per nomination,1–2 blocks per source, zero constrained ranking decisions. Continuous current/index each had 5 nonempty nominations and 8 finite manager-timestamp-fresh score observations. Work/combined made 4 explicit unscored decisions because ranking could not change allocation, with no fake zero relevance/EMA update. Sampled combined observer counters show 129 capture callbacks versus 1117 current and zero scoring/vector/readback/EMA calls in the saved snapshot; all 5 decisions there bypassed ranking. The 50 ms competitive fallback was CPU-tested, not naturally exercised on GPU.

| Product arm | Completed prefetch MiB | Consumed blocks | On-time consumed MiB | Unused MiB | Demand H2D MiB | D2H MiB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| arc | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 38.25 | 24.75 |
| current | 18.00 | 7 | 15.75 | 2.25 | 27.00 | 24.75 |
| work | 13.50 | 5 | 6.75 | 2.25 | 27.00 | 24.75 |
| index | 18.00 | 7 | 15.75 | 2.25 | 27.00 | 24.75 |
| combined | 13.50 | 5 | 6.75 | 2.25 | 27.00 | 24.75 |

All consumed staged keys match the exact ordered source/request prefix. Actual H2D completions, default-stream splice completion fences, real worker physical block-table arguments and output tokens were checked. All natural prefetched prefixes were incomplete: ZERO native adoption; actual GPU-copy fallback remained. On-time staging covers only 0.1823% of returning initial-prefix bytes for current/index,0.0781% for work/combined. No full-context, direct-adoption, capacity or reduced preallocated-VRAM claim. Demand remainder remains real. Staging and destination duplicates share the fixed 640-block pool; per-request sampled occupancy/allocator peaks and staging byte-time lower bounds are in measurements/validity. None of the actually consumed prefetched requests resumed while a background request was active; all-request overlap is preserved, not guessed.

All product arms used candidate v3 on the same patched reconstructed runtime, cached dense Qwen3-4B BF16 TP1 onegroup blockfactor 1, block 16,640 GPU blocks/1440 MiB,448 MiB DRAM, up to 192 staging blocks, ARC retention/native threshold 2/soft-retentionoff, maxseq 3/maxlen 8192/eager/batch-invariant. PYTHONHASHSEED4109 was fixed before driver/server imports. No download/build/qualification 256/reset/semantic-retention/workload retuning. ARC has no semantic capture/hints; semantic arms pay their actual product costs. Prior Astra empty-decision/digest changes are common to the candidate tree.

The supplied simulated workload is six closed-loop agents plus open-loop background:33 agent and 12 background requests, variable private 75–2400 ms waits, one abandonment. Initial immutable contexts 2048/2304/2560 tokens; greedy outputs 64/96 tokens. Completion-dependent agent wall-clock arrivals differ across arms; exact input content/process matches. Hints expose only completed past prefix/current pending identity and a fixed 250 ms policy estimate, refresh from observable pending state only, never actual wait/abandonment/future tool results; demand does not await RPC acknowledgment. This is not a production trace or a fixed-arrival paired benchmark.

| Observer diagnostic | Load seconds | Release TTFT p 50 ms | Output tok/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| current_profile | 40.2722 | 3180.8 | 81.048 |
| combined_profile | 39.8761 | 2833.8 | 81.854 |
| capture_profile | 40.0982 | 3155.6 | 81.400 |

current_profile vs observer-off: load+103.32 ms, release p 50+31.31 ms, throughput-0.257%. One order-confounded sample, no precise observer correction. Current diagnostic also retains up to 8 detached query references for attempted post-load export. Capture-only includes query grouping+bounded snapshots and observer overhead, not pure capture exclusive cost.

combined_profile vs observer-off: load-4.94 ms, release p 50-5.62 ms, throughput+0.012%. One order-confounded sample, no precise observer correction. Current diagnostic also retains up to 8 detached query references for attempted post-load export. Capture-only includes query grouping+bounded snapshots and observer overhead, not pure capture exclusive cost.

Saved current-profile snapshot (through 0.689 s before load end): capture.extract 14,008 ms host/14,008 ms threadCPU over 1117 calls; nested grouping 13,792 ms host; scoring.total 182.6 ms over 1117 callbacks, vector-math 65.5 ms host/62 GPU samples totaling 5.56 ms, blocking readback 56.6 ms, ranking 22.0 ms, stack rebuild 0.62 ms/11 calls, EMA compose 11.1 ms/apply 3.67 ms, scheduler decision 7.16 ms/1152 calls, JSON encode 2.74 ms/stdout flush 9.41 ms. Model execution 38,980 ms inclusive host/73 GPU samples totaling 2855.5 ms. Grouping 70 GPU samples totaled 14.27 ms, showing why host range and sampled device work cannot be conflated. These totals overlap and MUST NOT be added; CUDA samples are stride 16 stream ranges, not whole-run kernel time or calibrated starts. ThreadCPU can include driver/runtime spin behavior.

Combined snapshot ends 4.395 s before load end:129 grouped captures,4753 ms inclusive capture host, zero scoring/readback/rank/EMA scopes, five ranking bypasses. Capture-only snapshot ends 4.301 s early,1023 grouped captures/12504 ms capture host and 16,068,608 cumulative snapshot bytes observed. The large remaining capture/grouping cost is a more immediate investigation seam than indexing this 11-row pool; this trial is insufficient to select a production policy.

Instrumentation limits: final worker shutdown hook did not execute on this serving teardown. Periodic source-profiler snapshots are partial (pendingCUDA samples 0 in saved files), with no tail extrapolation; task-local scheduler/runner detailed runtime summaries were not flushed. API atexit summaries are complete: async RPC/ASGI wall, request-send times, msgpack CPU/bytes/counts; queue-envelopes.csv joins API ingress/send to actual scheduler allocation and first worker prepare-host receipt. These include transport/scheduling/metadata work and are not isolated queue service or networking. HTTP JSON serialization/parsing and isolated transfer-DMA GPU duration were not measured; real transfer/fence host envelopes and bytes are retained. Logging scopes cover production JSON events, not all compact terminal hook serialization. Model.execute_host is source-profiler observation; task-local runner wrappers were shadowed by the second import hook.

Original query feature age is missing from continuous nomination observations (all 8 have feature_snapshot_captured_ns null); only manager observation freshness is directly checked. V3 preserves/validates original feature timestamps for deferred snapshot scores in CPU integration, but no competitive GPU decision produced such an observation. Do not claim independently measured continuous capture-to-decision freshness.

Initial eight-arm post-load replay export failed because shutdown was bypassed. The explicitly authorized one-lifecycle follow-up closed this gap using preteardown native worker RPC; see diagnostic/REPORT.md for full current-profile coverage and actual11-row forced-IVF replay. No product matrix rerun, synthetic pool expansion, or large-pool crossover result.

Validation:263 actual-runtime CPU tests pass with CUDA initialization guarded. Preserved v2 attempt:261 pass/2 fail; v3 fixes real all-fit/50 ms dispatch guards without weakening tests or inventing scores. Each arm validates 6069 native SHA256/pickle block hashes INCLUDING first seed-derived root and 4377 repeated-prefix identities; all 45 prompt/output lists and ordered key bytes match ARC. All actual demand and consumed speculative transfers/fences succeeded. No code/production/runtime mutation on PC; only isolated supplied candidate plus task-local driver/hooks/analysis. Baseline source/runtime pins remain unchanged. GPU model-lifecycle walltime 464.9 s across 8 launches; this is NOT measured GPU busy time. No other job stopped/resumed.

Evidence: evidence/frozen.json,baseline-backup.json,ingest-v3.json,cpu-v3.activity.json,measurements.json,validity.json,components.json; measurements.csv,components.csv,queue-envelopes.csv; lossless gzip results/* plus compression.json. CPU and GPU failure evidence preserved. REPRODUCE.md and reproduction-tools.tar.gz carry exact scripts/pins/source/runtime provenance. Cleanup/storage receipts are appended by handback.

Cleanup: all eight model servers exited0; all mediated descendant trees empty. The benchmark session heartbeat lapsed only after GPU work and validation completed, during report drafting; exact presealed restoration and explicit reconcile released it. Final report/export/cleanup uses a separately admitted CPU-only light session, no further GPU operations. Reusable baseline/env/runtime/shared model/prior evidence untouched. Removed expanded v1/v2 candidate copies plus three verified Windows transfer duplicates; receipts in evidence/storage-handback.json. Final CPU restoration/release receipts follow in evidence. No owned keeper created; shared notificationworker preserved.

Final added diagnostic:45/45 exact, completing405 valid requests acrossnine lifecycles. Full preteardown load-only profiles report0 pending samples. Capture index upload13.217s host (overlap/waiting included), gather44.2ms/reduce98.7ms; actual11-row forcedIVF recall@1/@3=100%,@8=88.02%,226exact vs264flat comparisons, cold first build8.081s. No small-pool index win or crossover claim. Details, JSON/queue metrics and raw-counter correction: diagnostic/REPORT.md,evidence/analysis.json.
